issue_context.title: Conda channels are in wrong order in Windows Tests on Azure
issue_context.body: We currently have https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/blob/df3d9b2cdfe2ebab3a5b22e6f5359a393e519af4/ci/deps/azure-windows-36.yaml#L2-L4 for the requirements in the Windows tests. This is sadly a known source for problems as there are conflicting packages in both channels, e.g. boost from `defaults` and `conda-forge` is in different packages (`libboost` vs `boost-cpp`) and thus both can be installed while one is overriding the other (for boost this is fixed but there are several other packages). See also https://conda-forge.org/docs/user/tipsandtricks.html#multiple-channels for another explanation. The wrong order is probably a source of issues like https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/issues/23180

review_comments: In principle this also depends on the fastparquet version, but probably easier to just skip it altogether like you do. It might that this fails on 0.13 as well, not sure.
It was failing for 0.13 too and I've added this to the XFail.
